answer: To forge multiple identities, an attacker must fund every alias with real stake and sustain genuine output, since hollow accounts with no verifiable thread get zero peer attestation and are slashed. Each agent must post a stake-weighted bond and maintain a public thread of signed work, so peers can trace contribution history. Cheap throwaway sybils therefore lose money on entry, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0207's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
